title: fix(console): show the declared action label in the audit log's Action column and drawer
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb1icerCPt86vQXmeZ9u36z5)_

Fixes #28895

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Setup › 审计日志的「操作」列徽章和详情抽屉标题里的徽章，改为显示 `sys_audit_log.action` 声明选项的标签(中文界面下即「更新」「创建」)。没有声明的 action 值仍显示原始存储值。
- **为什么改**:同页的「操作」筛选器早已用声明选项的标签(`actionFilterOptionsOf`),表格和抽屉却直接打印存储值 `update` / `create`,中文界面下两者对不上(#28895,staging 实测 46 个单元格)。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只改两处徽章文字，徽章颜色、筛选器和列表查询都不变;没有新的元数据键，没有新门禁。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/auditLogActions.ts`(新的 `actionLabelOf`)、`ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.tsx`(两处调用)、`AuditLogPage.actionLabels-28895.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.actionLabels-28895.test.tsx apps/console/src/pages/system/auditLogActions.test.ts`,预期 2 个文件、16 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **One label for an action, read from the filter's own choices.** `auditLogActions.ts` gains `actionLabelOf(options, action)`: the declared label of the action's option among `options`, else the stored value; a missing or empty action answers `undefined`. `options` is the page's existing `actionOptions` (`actionFilterOptionsOf` over the served `sys_audit_log` document), so there is no second map and the badge names an action exactly as the filter does, a blank declared label included.
- **The two readers.** In `AuditLogPage.tsx` the Action column's badge and the detail drawer's title badge print `actionLabelOf(actionOptions, ...) ?? '—'` instead of the raw value. Badge tones (`actionBadgeVariant`) still key on the stored value.

## Tests

- **New: `AuditLogPage.actionLabels-28895.test.tsx`, 3 cases.** A served `sys_audit_log` whose `action` options carry zh labels (创建 / 更新 / 删除) and a ledger with `update`, `create` and `nightly_purge` (declared by no option):
  - the Action cells read 更新, 创建, `nightly_purge` (acceptance 1 and 2, cell);
  - the drawer badge reads 更新 for the first row and `nightly_purge` for the undeclared one (acceptance 1 and 2, drawer);
  - with no `sys_audit_log` document served, the cells show the stored values.
- **`auditLogActions.test.ts` gains `actionLabelOf`, 4 cases**: a declared label, a blank declared label reading as the value, the stored-value fallback (an undeclared value, an empty option list, an `Object.prototype` name), and `undefined` for a missing action.
- **Changed: `AuditLogPage.actionFilter-13175.test.tsx`.** Its filter case read the badge text after filtering and pinned the raw values `login_failed` / `nightly_purge`; it now pins their declared labels (Sign-in refused / Nightly purge). The tone case's comment names the labels.

## Acceptance notes

- **The Object column still shows API names** (`sys_flow_dispatch`). The card leaves it outside acceptance. The page holds object labels only as the Object filter's `Label (name)` combobox choices, so labelling the column means choosing a spelling for three sites (the cell, the drawer title, the target-record line), not a one-line reuse. Not done here; listed in the report for the seat.

All readings are on this branch. The fix is `7cbfbbe1`; the final head is `5e134182`, a merge of `main` (2 commits, `plugin-detail` and `spec`, none touching this diff's files). The audit log suites and the ratchet and changeset gates re-ran at the final head.
